answer.rationale: Memory 57 most directly supports sustainable qualified revenue because it reports qualified revenue gains and no measurable retention harm, though it is limited to established customers. Memory 73 reports strong acquisition and revenue lift, but omits retention, margins, discount durability, and customer quality. Memory 44 supports qualified pipeline but does not establish closed revenue or long-term value. Memory 31 shows a durable activation lift, but activation is only an intermediate outcome. Memories 86 and 91 likewise improve intermediate adoption outcomes without evidence of revenue quality, retention, or durability; memory 91 is weakest because it describes only week-one engagement and a first meaningful action.
